cases.name: Delfina Pan
cases.about: She was a graphic designer who attended the University of Buenos Aires, moved to Miami Beach two years ago, was an aspiring fashion designer and photographer, and worked at the Kansas Bar and Grill.
cases.narrative:
According to a neighbor and friend, he arrived at her apartment, uninvited, and waited for her. When she arrived, he asked to talk to her in her apartment. When she refused, the neighbor told police, “he produced a knife and without being provoked began to stab the victim.”
